spec.caption:
Five December bases with historical monthly averages of at least 25 C and no more than 80 mm rain.

Estimated costs: USD 1,300/month or less. Ordered by average rainfall.

1. Lagos, Nigeria: historical December averages of 27.6 C, 11 mm rain and 75% humidity. Estimated cost: USD 1,100/month.

Its site safety rating is 4/10, despite meeting the weather and budget filters.

2. Bangkok, Thailand: historical December averages of 27 C, 18 mm rain and 62% humidity.

Estimated cost: USD 1,100/month. Same budget as Lagos, with average humidity 13 percentage points lower.

3. Siem Reap, Cambodia: historical December averages of 25.3 C, 33 mm rain and 72% humidity.

Estimated cost: USD 800/month, including USD 280 rent, the lowest budget in this five-city shortlist.

4. Cartagena, Colombia: historical December averages of 27.5 C, 34 mm rain and 80% humidity. Estimated cost: USD 1,300/month.

Compared with Siem Reap: 1 mm more average rain and USD 500 more per month.

5. Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam: historical December averages of 26.7 C, 64 mm rain and 77% humidity.

Estimated cost: USD 1,000/month, USD 100 below Bangkok with 46 mm more average rain.
